- Complete and verify a playable, inclusive, text-based dating simulator with branching stories and hundreds of endings.

## Requirements
- Build without clarification; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them at completion.

## Decisions
- Created “All the Little Lights,” a responsive browser visual novel with six adult characters, customizable identity options, four scenes per route, and romance, friendship, or self-focused finales.
- Choices shape character stats and ending variations; identity and attraction preferences do not prevent meeting anyone.

## Work State
### Completed
- Implemented game shell, styling, six character routes, profile setup, choice-driven scenes, local saves, ending collection, and 648 ending variations.
- Fixed `finish()` throwing `ReferenceError: state is not defined` by moving it inside the game’s IIFE.
- Fixed ending text interpolating `undefined` for its motif theme.
- `node --check game.js` passed; browser-tested profile setup, route selection, scenes, and a romance finale path.

- `index.html`: Game entry page and app shell.
